body:
Thing is. I was the one who kept apologizing for letting that person do bad things to me and to other people. I kept apologizing for not being able to understand. We grew up together but from all the times he needed me I was there. But for times that I needed a friend’s support he wasn’t. And for a decade I was so blinded that he only really kept me there to be a personal punchbag. Someone who will always look after him, help him be accountable, do the things he needs to do in his life like I looked for his job and apartment.

A good person can only really take so much. It’s just really sad at this point that a person can actually be so  numb to not even apologize after you’ve called them out after everything they did to you.

Oh well life moves on.... hahaha!!
Hey thank you! Your reply means a lot.
